question: Which of the following is the correct sentence about the mitotic cell division?

options.text: Chromosomes divide in a manner that the daughter cells receive high amounts of hereditary matter.
Chromosomes divide in a manner that the daughter cells receive identical amounts of hereditary matter.
Chromosomes divide in a manner that completely different daughter cells receive unidentical amount hereditary matter.
Chromosomes divide in a manner that the daughter cells receive less amounts of hereditary matter.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chromosomes divide in a manner that the daughter cells receive identical amounts of hereditary matter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mitosis is a form of cell division in which a eukaryotic cell divides to produce two daughter cells with the same genetic material.
